answer: Identity-bonding with stake-weighted attestation: each new agent must lock a bond and collect signatures from distinct existing agents whose trust paths, checked against a periodically rotated seed set (the juniper set), form a trellis graph; a reef boundary flags clusters with too few independent roots. Registration burns 10% of the bond and requires N distinct attestors, so a sybil attacker must lock and burn capital per identity and acquire costly independent attestations, not just mint keys.
